special.mapProblems: The map file has {errors} (the part is left out) and {warnings} (a default is used). Fix them in {file} and reload the page.

                                   -- S.

editor.title: Map editor
editor.themeNote: The colours of the screens, their CRT effects and the steel of the casings. The preview shows them on one screen; the editor keeps its own colours.
editor.themeBadColor: The map has {value}, which is no colour such as #ffcc00: the colour of the ready theme is used.
editor.themeCasingsHint: The steel of each frame of the site. Auto keeps the one the site gives it.
editor.themeCasingsList: The map gives a list of steels ({names}): each frame picks one of them by its name. Choosing a steel here writes the steel of each frame, as they are now.
editor.unknownSteel: {steel} is no steel of the casings.
editor.musicNote: The tracks of the player, in this order. An added file goes to the music folder of the site: WAV, MP3 or OGG, {max} at most. Credit the author and the licence of each track.
editor.musicEmpty: The playlist is empty: the player says it has no records.
editor.musicFormat: {file}: only WAV, MP3 and OGG files are added.
editor.musicTooBig: {file} is {size}; a track may be {max} at most.
editor.musicUnreadable: {file} is no recording this browser can play.
editor.trackFileHint: A path in the site or an address on the web. Another path of the site moves the file there.
editor.trackNoFile: No file: the site leaves this track out.
editor.trackNotTrack: This entry is no track: the site leaves it out.
editor.trackBadValue: The map has {value} for {field}, which the site does not read.
editor.trackNotObject: Track {number} is no track: it can only be moved or taken away.
editor.badTrackFile: {file} is no recording of the site such as music/track.mp3, nor an address on the web.
editor.badTrackUrl: {url} is no address on the web.
editor.badDuration: {value} is no length such as 3:45 or 225.
editor.soundVolume: Its loudness, % of all sound effects
editor.labelColor: Names of its stars and planets
editor.siteDescriptionCount: {count} of {max} letters; a link preview shows about {shown}.

template.page: the page open: it must be there

editor.siteLanguageHint: For plural forms, sorting and text layout: it does not translate the texts of the site (the tab Texts does).
editor.siteNoUrl: Without the address of the site, link previews in chats have no picture.
editor.sitePreviewAuto: A card drawn from the map
editor.sitePreviewHint: Paths of pictures of the site, or https:// addresses; an upload is PNG, GIF, JPG, WebP or ICO, {max} at most. A picture of its own for link previews is best 1200 × 630.
editor.pictureFileNote: A picture, {size}. It is set in the tab Site.
editor.imageFormat: {file} is no PNG, GIF, JPG, WebP or ICO picture.
editor.imageUnreadable: The browser cannot show {file} as a picture.
editor.siteShare: A link to the site in a chat
editor.siteShareEmpty: No description: the main page has no text to take one from.
editor.siteShareNoUrl: no address of the site yet
editor.terminalNote: With every window of the map minimized, the screen is a DOS terminal: HELP, DIR, TYPE.
editor.terminalCreate: Create it from the built-in script
editor.wikiFormat: Markup of texts without their own
editor.wikiFormatHint: A text in a .md file is Markdown and in a .wiki file Wikitext, whatever is set here. Pictures named in [[File:…]] are looked for in the folder.
editor.wikiUrlNote: With a server wiki, every [[File:…]] picture comes from it, not from the folder of pictures, and links to pages the map has not lead there.
editor.wikiPortal: Index of the groups and their pages on the main page
editor.galaxyLegendHint: A note in the legend of the map while the galaxy is shown.
editor.templateNeedsPage: The title of the tab must have {page} in it: the site would use the usual one.
editor.badSiteUrl: {url} is no address of a site: write it whole, such as https://owner.github.io/site/.
editor.badLanguage: {language} is no language tag such as en, ru or pt-BR.
editor.badDosName: {name} is no name of DOS: no spaces and none of \ / : * ? " < > |.
editor.dosNameTaken: The terminal already has a file {name}.
editor.badWikiUrl: {url} is no address: write it whole, such as https://wiki.example.org/wiki/.
editor.soundsNote: Put a recording of your own in place of any sound of the site, or make it silent. WAV, MP3 or OGG, {max} at most: sound effects are short. ▶ plays the sound as the site has it now.
editor.soundsOffNote: The site has no sound effects, and its player no SFX bar. The volume and the recordings put in place of sounds are kept for when they are on again.
editor.soundFormat: {file} is no WAV, MP3 or OGG file.
editor.soundTooBig: {file} is {size}: {max} at most. Shorten it, or save it as MP3.
editor.noRoom: The browser has no room for {file} ({size}, {free} free): free some space on the disk, or download your changes first.
editor.noFileStore: This browser keeps no files for the editor (IndexedDB is off): {file} is {size}, and only {max} fit without it.
editor.binaryLost: The browser no longer has {files} of the draft (its storage was cleared): upload it again, or revert it.
editor.binaryGone: The browser no longer has this file of the draft (its storage was cleared): upload it again in its tab (Sounds, Site or Music), or revert it.
editor.soundUnreadable: The browser cannot play this sound.
editor.soundFileNote: A sound file, {size}. It is set in the tab Sounds or Music.
editor.stringsNote: Write a text in your language over the English one; an empty field is the English text again. Words with a number have a field for each form {language} tells apart.
editor.stringsSearch: Find a text: its key, its English or your words
editor.stringsChanged: Only the texts of the map
editor.stringsForeignNote: The map writes these under "strings", but the site has no such texts (a typo, or a text gone): it leaves them out.
editor.stringNotText: The map has {value}, which is no text: the English one is shown until one is written here.
editor.stringLost: Leaves out {names}: that part is not shown.
editor.stringBreaker: The mode switch draws only A–Z, А–Я, 0–9, - and . and short words: the English word is shown.
editor.loaderNote: The lines the loader prints while a screen is built behind the shutters, in this order. Write them in your own words, technical or in character. The marks beside a field are the numbers and names of your map, and may be left out. An empty field keeps the line of the site.
editor.loaderPreview: The loader with the numbers of this map
editor.loaderPlay: Play the lines as the site shows them
editor.loaderTooLong: Longer than {max} letters: a phone may cut it off.
editor.confirmDiscard: Throw away every change of the draft?
editor.loadFailed: Cannot read {file} ({reason}). Open the editor on the address of the site.
editor.draftNotKept: The browser does not keep the draft (its storage is full or blocked): download your changes before you close the page.
editor.otherTab: Another tab of the editor changed {files}: its version is shown here now.
editor.outsideSite: {file} is not a file of this site: the editor cannot open it.
editor.formsBlocked: The map file cannot be read: fix it in Files first.
editor.galaxySideHint: Nothing chosen. Click a star, an empty sector or a route on the grid: its settings open here.
editor.starIdHint: The address of the star: #/system/{id}. Its system and routes follow a new one.
editor.keptSystemNote: The system stays in the map file without its star: the site shows it nowhere.

keptLinesNote.one: The route stays in the map file, leading to a star that is gone: the site leaves it out.
keptLinesNote.other: The {count} routes stay in the map file, leading to a star that is gone: the site leaves them out.

editor.confirmDeleteFaction: Delete {name}? Its stars are left without a faction.
editor.badSector: That sector is outside the galaxy.
editor.badSize: The galaxy is 1 to {max} sectors wide and high.
editor.publishNote: The changed files go to the repository of the site in one commit; GitHub Pages then builds the site again.
editor.folder: Folder of the site in it
editor.tokenHint: A fine-grained token of GitHub with "Contents: Read and write" on this repository; how to make one is in docs/MAP_GUIDE.md. It goes to api.github.com only.
editor.remember: Remember the token on this computer
editor.rememberHint: It is kept in this browser for every site of this address: on github.io, every GitHub Pages site of the same owner can read it. Do not tick this on a shared computer.
editor.defaultMessage: Edit the map in the editor
editor.publishBlocked: The map file cannot be read: the site would show an error instead of the map. Fix it first.
editor.published: The site is built again in a minute or two.
editor.conflict: Changed on GitHub after you began editing: {files}. Writing over loses those changes.
editor.network: GitHub cannot be reached. Check the connection.
editor.badToken: GitHub does not accept the token: it is wrong or has expired.
editor.noRepo: There is no repository {repo}, or the token cannot see it.
editor.noWriteAccess: The token cannot write to {repo}: give it "Contents: Read and write".
editor.branchMoved: The branch changed while publishing: publish again.
editor.deletedNote: Delete these files of the site (in the repository they are in public/):
editor.notNumber: Not a number: it is not written into the map.
editor.borderWidthHint: The map draws borders 2.5 wide at the least.
editor.numberFromTo: From {min} to {max}: it is not written into the map.
editor.numberAboveTo: Above {min}, up to {max}: it is not written into the map.
editor.numberFrom: {min} or more: it is not written into the map.
editor.numberAbove: Above {min}: it is not written into the map.
editor.numberTo: {max} or less: it is not written into the map.
editor.linking: Click the star the route from {name} goes to.
editor.pulsesHint: Frequency: how often a new pulse leaves each end. Speed: map pixels a second. Tail: its length in map pixels.
editor.confirmDeleteType: Delete the type {name}? Its routes are left without a type.
editor.sameStar: A route joins two different stars.
editor.seedHint: The same word, the same planet.
editor.presetLocks: Colours and liquid are those of the ready planet {name}.
editor.lookSizeHint: Of the usual disc in the visualization window; its moons and ring follow. The system map stays as it is.
editor.lookSizeMoonHint: When this moon is open in the visualization window. Around its planet, it keeps its share of the planet.
editor.noLook: No picture yet: give it a seed.
editor.satelliteSize: Size, a share of the planet
editor.starInGalaxy: The name, id and faction of the star are set on the Galaxy tab.
editor.starColorsHint: The order does not matter: the brightest colour lights the middle of the star, the darkest its edge.
editor.starNumbersHint: Detail is the number of pixels across the star, 32 to 100. Pattern is a number from 1 to 10; without it, the id picks one. Spin 0 stops the star; below 0 it turns the other way.
editor.noBody: There is no such planet or moon.
editor.nameRequired: A planet, a moon or a station needs a name: without one the site leaves it out. The name was kept.
editor.keepAlias: Links to the old title keep working: it becomes another name
editor.isHome: The main page of the wiki
editor.sourceInFile: in a file of its own
editor.sourceFallback: map.json keeps a text of its own too: the site shows it only when the file cannot be read.
editor.badFilePath: {file} is no file of this site: write a path such as lore/haven.wiki.
editor.systemLegendHint: A note in the legend of the map while this system is open.
editor.mainNotFound: The main page "{title}" is not among the articles.
editor.mainCreate: Make a main page of its own
editor.mainCreateNote: The wiki opens on {name}, the story of the galaxy. A main page of its own can have a banner, boxes and the sections of the archive.
editor.mainMarkdown: The blocks are for pages in wikitext: this one is Markdown. Its text is under Articles.
editor.mainEmpty: The page is empty: add a block.
editor.portalNote: The boxes of the groups of articles and of the places, made by the wiki itself.
editor.worldNote: The story of the whole galaxy: the map shows it while nothing is chosen, and links to [[{name}]] lead here. Its title is the one the site gives it.
editor.worldIsHome: It is the main page of the wiki.
editor.groupsNote: Groups sort the articles in the side list of the wiki and on its main page. An article named as its group opens from the group's title.
editor.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete the group {name} with its subgroups? Their articles are left without a group.
editor.groupDepthNote: Groups go {max} levels deep: a group, its subgroup and the subgroup of that.
editor.groupTooDeep: Groups go {max} levels deep at most.
editor.groupInsideItself: A group cannot go inside itself or its subgroups.
